summary: C45 removed the earlier continued-eating prompt mismatch: the v12 case now matches through the `Continue eating?` screen and the answer `y`. On the next bite, eat.c:lesshungry crosses 2000 nutrition while `victual.canchoke` is true and calls eat.c:choke with the meal. C first calls exercise(A_CON,FALSE), producing rn2(2)=1 @ exercise(attrib.c:509), then rn2(20)=12 @ choke(eat.c:258) selects the fatal branch and `done(CHOKING)`; JS instead continues into monster movement and has no screen at step 7. Port the whole choke helper and wire its active meal, tin, and strangulation-amulet caller, preserving bite()’s nonzero return when choking is survived.

dependencies: attrib.c:exercise(A_CON,FALSE) is already implemented in js/attrib.js; choke discards its return, while its RNG and possible encumber_msg side effect must remain ordered.

Role_if(PM_KNIGHT), u.ualign.type, adjalign(-1), You_feel, You, Hunger, Breathless, and Strangled are source state/format predicates. Hunger checks intrinsic or extrinsic HUNGER; Breathless checks magical breathing or current-form breathlessness; Strangled is exactly the intrinsic STRANGLED value. The corresponding state/message helpers are present in js/eat.js and js/attrib.js.
eat.c:morehungry is already implemented in js/eat.js; it calls newuhs after lowering u.uhunger.
eat.c:vomit is a separate partial helper in js/eat.js. choke discards its result; for unsupported vomit branches preserve an exact note_unported gap rather than simulating effects.
eat.c:foodword is already implemented in js/eat.js; objnam.c:killer_xname is already implemented for ordinary non-artifact, non-corpse food and its string is consumed to populate svk.killer.name.
end.c:done(CHOKING) is already implemented in js/end.js; its return value is not consumed by choke. Preserve its awaited life-saving/game-over behavior.
